adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/hubspot/lib/CalendarService.ts`, `refreshAccessToken` assigns `const hubspotRefreshToken: HubspotToken = await refreshOAuthTokens(...)`. But `refreshOAuthTokens` (new in the diff) returns a `fetch(...)` `Response` object when `APP_CREDENTIAL_SHARING_ENABLED && CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT && userId` is true, and it does not parse JSON or validate the shape. Hubspot’s code also does not call `parseRefreshTokenResponse` (unlike Google/Office365/Zoom in the diff). So when sync is enabled, `hubspotRefreshToken` will not be a `HubspotToken`-shaped object and any later property reads (e.g., access token/expiry) will be wrong/undefined at runtime.
